provenance.band_rule: analytic Rashba continuum band interval with 1e-8 t tolerance at T=0 and in Tc solver
provenance.interpretation: Relaxed archives are read-only. Every unique stage-1 point is re-solved strictly; ratios are reused only if the strict root matches the archived relaxed root. Stage-2 points with out-of-band SC mu are omitted, not set to zero.
provenance.caveat: Strict admissibility does not compare free energies between multiple in-band roots.
